/policy/privacy-policy.description: Courso is a focused single-page template crafted for online educators, coaches, and course creators. It helps you present courses, value, and outcomes clearly while guiding learners to enroll with confidence.
h2: Meet the mentor behind your low-code  mastery journey
h4: Data Tracking Related to Course Access
p: We want every student to feel confident when joining our online solo course. Since this is a digital learning program with immediate access to all lessons, resources, and downloadable files, we are committed to protecting your personal information and ensuring transparency in how your data is collected, used, and safeguarded. Please read the policy below carefully before enrolling.

When you sign up for the course, we collect the information necessary to provide access to your learning content and support services. This includes details such as your name, email address, payment information, course activity, and records of which files or materials you access within the platform. These details are gathered automatically when you enroll, make a purchase, participate in lessons, or contact our support team.

Your personal information is used only to deliver the course experience you paid for. This includes granting course access, processing your payment, supporting your learning progress, improving the content and features of the program, and assisting you if you request help. We do not sell or share your information with outside parties for advertising or promotional purposes.

Because the course provides immediate access to digital materials such as videos, templates, and downloadable files, the system keeps track of which resources you open or download. This allows us to monitor platform security, confirm authorized use of content, and provide accurate support if you experience technical issues.

Your information is kept for as long as your account is active or for the period required to meet legal, financial, and administrative obligations. Even after an account is closed, certain details may remain stored if necessary to comply with legal duties or regulatory requirements.

Depending on the laws of your region, you may have the ability to request access to your stored information, correct inaccurate details, ask for the removal of your data when allowed, or limit the ways your information is processed. If you would like to exercise these rights, you may contact us directly and our team will assist you.

We prioritize the security of your information by using protective measures such as encrypted storage and restricted access. While no online system can guarantee absolute security, we follow recognized industry standards to reduce risks as much as possible. Students are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login details and should avoid sharing access with others.
If you have any questions about this refund policy or need assistance, please email our support team anytime & we will respond around 3 days:info@courso.com
